text: EXT. TRAIN STATION – DAY

FARRA EWING (47, female), DEMI (27, female, one of Farra's employees) and 5 other employees, some wear Santa hats, red nose reindeer makeup, and some carry a jingle bell or a speaker playing Christmas carols, some are holding a sign that says "Merry Christmas".
This is gonna be the peak of my Christmas! I can't believe I get to meet Riley Diaz today! DEMI GARCIA, in a short Christmas-style red dress, agrees along in excitement.

Yes! Mr. Diaz! Our auto plant investor and the chairman of the Walton Group! And I heard he's super cute! I can't wait to meet him and wish him a Merry Christmas! FARRA EWING, in a red skirt and black blazer, turns to her employees, slightly anxious.
Alright, everyone, check the time.

Mr. Diaz should be here any minute. Let's make sure we look our best! The employees quickly fix their hair and straighten their clothes. Demi and the other female employee exchange a quick look, checking each other‘s makeup. Two LUXURY CARS pull up. Bodyguards form a neat line along the car door. One opens the door of the second car. SLOW MOTION: RILEY DIAZ, dressed in a sleek suit with a candy cane pin on his lapel, confidence written all over his face and every movement, steps out the car. Demi and the employees’ eyes widen in awe.
Lord save me. He's young, rich, and so handsome... He's just perfect!

Mr. Diaz! Farra leads the group to greet him. The bells jingle as the employees rush forward. Two excited employees spray confetti over Riley. Everyone welcomes and wishes him a merry Christmas. Riley
Everyone welcomes and wishes him a merry Christmas. Riley raises a hand to shield his face against the confetti, brushing it off with a small smile.
Whoa, whoa! You guys came prepared! Farra steps forward to shake his hand, beaming.
Merry Christmas, Mr. Riley! It’s an honor to have you back in Ravenham. We've prepared a welcome dinner for you tonight!
You're too kind, Farra. I just had a meeting with the governor, and now I need to head to my wife's place for Christmas lunch, so I can't talk long.
Oh we definitely understand, sir! Just before you go, please accept these Christmas gifts we've prepared for you.
The bodyguards present the gifts.
Royal craftsman-made diamond brooch, vintage wine from Hall's Vineyard, and a few exquisite porcelain pieces!
Wow! I didn't have time to pick out anything for my wife's family, and you've just saved me the trouble.
He takes out his phone, types and sends a text message.
By the way, my wife works at the auto plant. I just sent you her info. Can you take care of it?
No problem, sir. Demi is in a daze mesmerized by Riley. Farra checks her phone, shocked, as she reads the message.
His wife is Caroline Baker?
They both watch Riley as he walks away, talking into his phone.
Oh, and Draven doesn't like crowds. I should send the bodyguards back.
You piece of shit! I'll kill you!
Let go of him! You nut case!
You're dead meat now!
No, no, Andrew, please forgive Riley. Don't hurt him. He doesn't mean any disrespect. Riley, let him go. Riley glances at Caroline, then lets go of Andrew.
That's it. I'm calling my security right now. They'll teach you a lesson!
No!
Enough! We're here to spend Christmas together. Let's eat. Anyone not interested can leave.
Everyone quiets down, though Andrew, Doris, and the others still look upset.

Grandpa's right. Why don't we all calm down. It was just a misunderstanding. Let's go. Andrew and the others, still fuming, follow Draven to the dining room. Caroline sighs in relief and takes Riley's hand.
Come on, Riley, you need to stop saying crazy things like that. You know how much I worry about you!
Don't worry, darling. I'll be fine.
Just be careful, Riley. Riley smiles, nodding, and they head to the dining room together.
EXT. BAKER HOUSE – DAY
Riley approaches the door with gifts in hand as a car pulls up. CAROLINE BAKER(27) and ANDREW SMITH(25) step out.
Caroline? Caroline, caught off guard for a moment, then smiles, excited.
Riley? You're back!

Got me a slow year, so I'm able to come back and spend Christmas with you! Who's this? Andrew walks over to Caroline's side, sporting a smug smile. DORIS CLARK (50s, Caroline's mother) steps out of the house.
Oh, look who's back. Finally went bankrupt? Good, hurry up, you and Caroline can finally get a divorce! Riley frowns, caught off guard.
INT. BAKER HOUSE - DINING ROOM - DAY
The table is laden with food. The group sits down as Andrew pours a glass of wine and hands it to Draven.
Draven, try this wine. It's a top- tier vintage from Freya Vineyard. I picked it out just for you. Drake takes the glass with a smile, sips it.
This is some excellent wine!
Andrew's the best! Each bottle from Freya Vineyard costs hundreds of thousands. Draven keeps sipping, impressed.

This is indeed a rare treat! Thank you for sharing it with us, Andrew. Andrew waves it off, looking smug, then reaches for Caroline's hand. She pulls away. Andrew's expression darkens, and he looks at Riley with arrogance. Riley remains cold. DRAVEN Come on, everyone, let's eat!
The group starts eating. Draven cuts into his food and takes a bite, then frowns.
Oh, my God, this taste…
Drake, what's wrong?
Did you add something to this sauce?
Just some of the cheap wine Riley brought. Why? Draven slams his fist down on the table, outraged.
Are you insane?! Do you realize what you have done!
EXT. BAKER HOUSE – DAY
Doris, long time no see. Merry Christmas! Doris takes out the divorce papers.
Enough chit-chat. Here are the divorce papers. Sign them. Caroline, annoyed, takes the papers.
Mom, Riley came all the way here to spend Christmas with us. You really have to bring this up now?
Spend Christmas with us? We don't need his company! We'd all be happier without him around.
Doris!
Enough, Doris! Stop being so mean to him! Don't worry, Riley, I'm not divorcing you. The only reason we asked Andrew here was so that he can help us take the gifts to the Draven's.
You're so naive! You married a loser who can't even earn a dime! You have a wealthy and handsome suitor right here, yet you're still living with this loser!
A suitor? Doris grabs Andrew over to her side, and looks at him with pride.
Andrew here is the R&D director at Ravenham Auto Plant, and his father is the deputy plant manager. If it weren't for you, Caroline would have married him and become a rich wife by now!

Come on, Doris. I know you're right, but let's not be too hard on the poor guy. Andrew reaches to put his arm around Caroline's shoulder. Caroline flinches and quickly pulls away. Andrew's expression darkens slightly. Riley gives Andrew a cold stare.
What's wrong, boy? Got a problem with me?
I just want you to stay away from my wife. And as for " poor" , do you two know what you're talking about?
What else would you be? You're so broke you can't even afford a car! And now you're telling Andrew to keep his distance from Caroline?
Mom! Please, just stop talking!
Why should I? I'm only speaking the truth! Riley, look at Andrew's car. You'll never own something like that in your life! Riley looks at Andrew's car parked along the street.
You're right. I'll never have a car like that. Andrew's face lights up with pride.
Oh, so you do know your place. I was thinking you might rent something ridiculous just to impress Caroline. Riley's eyes move from the car to the two of them.
That Porsche is so cheap, it didn't even make it to the last year's international auto expo. So you're tight, I'll never buy one of those. Doris and Andrew are stunned.
EXT. BAKER HOUSE – DAY
Ha! Riley, even your jokes are terrible! You really think you can buy one? Do you have that kind of money?
An international auto expo? Do you even know what that is? That's where the real elites gather. You think you'd be invited?
Actually, yes. This was my first time attending the thing. They've been asking me to come for years, but I was always too busy.
Oh, they have been asking you for years, and you turned them down? Let me guess, did the governor also invite you to his party?
You mean Henry? I didn't hear about any party.
Unbelievable! He's such a clown!
Riley, come on. Time to... stop with these fairy tales, don't you think?
Caroline, there are things you don't know yet. I'll explain it all to you later.

Caroline, the chairman of the Wharton Group just arrived in Ravenham. I need to get back and help my dad prepare the welcome dinner. I don't have time to listen to this clown. I'll see you later at our Christmas lunch. Andrew gets into his car and drives off. Doris glares at Riley.
This is all your fault! Now Andrew's upset! Just let Caroline be with Andrew already!

Mom, that's enough. Let's go inside. Cornell is still waiting for us. Doris storms angrily into the house. Caroline turns to Riley with a reassuring smile. CAROLINE Riley, mom's pretty hot-tempered. Please don't take it to heart. You know I'll always be on your side. Riley holds onto her hand gratefully.

Babe, you're the one who waited for me for three whole years. And I will be forever grateful. Just know that wherever you are, that's where I'll be. Riley kisses on her hand, then they embrace, quietly sharing a moment.
I've missed you so much. I'm so glad you're back. Riley kisses Caroline. Her phone rings. Caroline gestures at the phone, and Riley smiles and gives her an "OK" hand gesture. CAROLINE Hello? Demi?
Oh my God, Caroline! You'll never guess happened! I just saw the chairman of the Wharton Group—he's so young, rich, and sooo handsome!
It was like...I fell in love at first sight!
Riley and Caroline stand outside the house. Riley smiles warmly at Caroline, who waves her phone at Riley.
My good friend, Demi, the shining star of the Ravenham Auto Plant, I'll introduce you next time. You go ahead inside, I'll catch up in a minute.
Alright. Caroline puts the phone back to her ear, and smiles.
Wow! He was that charming, huh?
He's totally my type! Oh, by the way, Caroline, I heard your husband's back. How's he doing after all those years away?
Alright I guess. But that's okay, we're still living our best lives!
Ha. Caroline Baker, always the optimist. Later, you're gonna help me pick out a sizzling dress. I need to capture our young hot chairman at the welcome party!
You got it, girl. Good luck! Caroline hangs up then runs to catch up with Riley. He takes her hand, they exchange a warm smile, and enter the house together.
INT. BAKER HOUSE - DAY
Riley and Caroline walk in. HEIDI(30, Caroline's sister), NICK(30, Caroline's brother-in-law), CORNELL(52, Caroline's dad), Doris are seated on the couch.
Hey, Caroline, your long-lost husband finally made it back?
Riley was just working out of town.
Good to know. I was afraid we'd see him on the news for robbing a bank and getting arrested.
That's never gonna happen, Heidi.
Alright, alright, Heidi's just messing around. Riley, are those gifts for us?
Yes, Nick, pick whatever you like. Riley opens the gifts he brought.

This is it? Riley is momentarily taken aback. Heidi steps forward and starts poking at the gifts. HEIDI Looks like plastic brooches, some wine from a fake vineyard, and cheap ceramics that wouldn't even sell for ten bucks? Heidi turns to Caroline. HEIDI Aye, Caroline, you sure your man's not playing some joke on us?
Riley and Caroline are surrounded by Doris, Cornell, Nick, and Heidi.
Heidi, you know Riley's been through a lot. I'm sure he handpicked these!
No, Caroline, these are pretty valuable, especially the wine! That's a rare collection from Freya Vineyard!
Cut the crap! Freya Vineyard is top-notch, and this label clearly says it's from Hall's Vineyard!
Never heard of Hall's Vineyard! Probably some roadside dump! Might not even be safe to drink!
Hall's Vineyard was its old name a century ago. This is their last rare batch. Even money won't buy another one of these! Cornell, getting impatient, gets up.
Stop lying, Riley. I've been drinking wine for years, and I've never heard of Freya having another name! You're just making things up!
That just means you don't know enough about wine, Cornell.
Alright, Riley, enough! Even if these are just simple gifts, it's fine! We appreciate them!
But Caroline…
Let's just use the wine for cooking, and pawn the brooches and ceramics. There's a thing going on at Kesso Trading where junks like these can sell for ten bucks.
Sounds like a plan. With that money, Riley, you might actually turn a profit on this trash. Not a bad deal if you ask me!
Heidi, you're still the brain of this family!
I'm at a loss for words to describe your ignorance, ladies and gentlemen. Mr. Draven, the former leader of the auto plant, is well- versed enough to recognize the value of these items…
You clown, are you insulting us?
No, I'm just stating something that is about to happen. Draven will make you look like idiots, and you will be crying in front of me saying how sorry you are.
Nick takes a few steps toward Riley, staring at him.
What's your problem, man?
You think we're too dumb to realize how precious your little gifts are? I knew you were broke, but didn't know how big of a loser you are!
Actually, I'm not broke at all.
Please stop, Riley's had a tough time. We're family. Who cares about how cheap or expensive are some Christmas gifts? It's all about being together!

Caroline, you're hopeless! Caroline sighs and pulls Riley down to sit on the couch. Suddenly, MIKE(7, Heidi's son) comes running in the room, crying. Heidi swoops him up in a hurry, soothing him. HEIDI Mike? Sweetie, what's wrong?
Mom! My favorite toy car is broken!
Oh no, your favorite one? Don't worry, Mike, we'll get a new one!
But I want that car!
Stop crying, Mike. They stopped making that toy car for years. You need to learn to be a little man and not cry over some broken toys!
No! I want my car!
Nick, it's Christmas. Don't be so hard on him!
But Doris, that toy only came with real car purchases. There's nothing I can do!
Andrew's dad is the deputy director at the auto plant. Caroline, you could ask Andrew. Maybe he could get Mike another one!
Great idea, Doris! Please, Caroline, help us out!
No, no, no. That man seems a bit too interested in Caroline. As her husband, I think my wife should keep her distance from him.
Riley, I don't mind asking him, if it's just to help Mike.
No need for you to go through the trouble, babe. I'll get Mike a new one myself.
Everyone looks suspiciously at Riley.
Really?
Yes, Mike can get a new car and the toy model that comes with it. Consider it my Christmas gift to him.
Everyone pauses, then bursts out laughing.
Caroline, your husband is a riot! Without him, I'd have missed out on so many laughs today!
Buy a real car to get the toy. How come we didn't think of that?
Mike, come here! Mike runs over to Riley, who writes a note, stamps it, and hands it to Mike. RILEY Go ahead, Mike, pick out any car you like. The car and the toy will be my Christmas gift to you!
Awesome! Mike takes the note and runs out. Heidi chases after him.
Wait. Mike! Mike! You lying jerk! Mike is gonna be devastated!
Riley! He's just a kid!
I told you not to marry him! Doris angrily slams divorce papers on the table. DORIS You piece of trash, divorce my Caroline right now, and get out of our house! Cornell can barely contain his anger.
Doris, it's Christmas. Let's all stay calm. How about this, Riley? I got an old friend, Bob, he's the factory deputy director. Come with me, and I'll ask him to set you up with a decent job.
Cornell, I appreciate you trying to help, but Bob can't get me the kind of job I need.
What kind of job do you want? Chairman of the Wharton Group? Grow up, Riley. Take whatever you can get! It's settled. After dinner, you and I are going to see Bob.
EXT. AUTO PLANT - DAY
Mike is pacing outside, holding the note in his hand, peeking inside nervously. EAMON(late 30s) approaches him.
Hey kid, what are you doing here? Shouldn't you be home for Christmas?
Are you the man who works at the auto plant? Eamon is taken aback for a moment.
Yeah, I am. I'm the head of the inspection department. Just doing a final check on some cars before I leave. But you, kid, you should be at home. Mike eagerly hands Eamon the note.
My uncle gave me this note. He said I can pick out a car and get the toy that comes with it! Eamon sighs and takes the note, ready to dismiss it.

Oh boy, another one of those silly pranks. I bet this is just as useless... Eamon glances at the note, and suddenly, his expression changes. EAMON Oh my God... Is this real? This has the Wharton Group Chairman's seal on it?
Mister, can I go in and pick a car now? Eamon, still in shock, reexamines the note, then looks at Mike in disbelief.
Uh... yes. Yes, of course. Please, follow me... sir .
INT. BAKER HOUSE - DAY
Riley, Caroline, Doris, Cornell, Nick, and Heidi are in the living room.
Riley! What's the deal here? I try to help you get a job, and you just throw it back in my face?
Someone like you should show some respect to Bob, and not act like some smart-ass!
Riley, I'm warning you! If you care more about your so called dignity than getting a job, then you really are the biggest fool in the world! Mike bursts in, waving a toy, thrilled.
Nick! Heidi! Look!
Everyone looks at him, surprised.
Did you really get the same toy?
And a car! Mr. Eamon drove it over for me!
A- a car? Riley smiles as everyone heads outside, where Eamon is just parking the car at the front door. He steps out of the car.
Is this spot okay, little buddy?
Perfect! Thanks, mister! Eamon smiles, waves, then leaves on foot. Everyone else just stares at the luxury car in shock and exchange stunned glances.
INT. BECK HOUSE - DAY
Everyone is gathered inside, still processing what just happened. Heidi mutters to herself.
That...that's a limited edition Phantom. It's at least in the eight-figure range. Am I dreaming?
This is real, right? I can't believe Riley actually managed to get a car like this! Doris and Caroline both turn to Riley, shocked. Riley simply smiles.
This is ridiculous! Mike, how did you get that car? Mike waves the note with excitement.
I just gave Mr. Eamon this note, like this, and he took me to see the cars! He even said the seal on it was really important!
Seal? What seal?
Nick takes the note and examines it closely. After a moment, a realization hits him.
I get it now! I know how Mike got that car, and I know exactly what kind of dirty trick Riley was pulling!
What are you talking about?
He's a damn fraud, that's what he is!
Nick, what are you saying? If you know something, just tell us!
This note got the toy because of the seal on it! You forged the Wharton Group's executive seal, didn't you? You tricked that guy into giving Mike the car!
So that's it! You can just pull out a fake seal like that. Clearly, you've done this before! You're a con artist!
God, you're nothing but trash!
Wait! Wait! Maybe this is just a huge misunderstanding! Riley stands there, stunned.
Everyone is still in the living room, the tension thick in the air.
Caroline! Don't you get it? Your husband Riley, he is a fraud!
No, I do not believe Riley would do something like that!
You're right, Caroline, you have to trust me. Doris, I hate to say this but you've got it all wrong.
Wrong? What could we possibly be wrong about? Explain that damn seal!
That is because I'm actually...
Caroline! I brought Christmas gifts! Caroline looks towards the door as Doris and Cornell exchange looks.
It's Andrew! He's finished with work and came to see Caroline!
We'll deal with Riley's shit later. Let's not embarrass ourselves in front of Andrew!
Everyone heads to the door to greet Andrew, who enters with a smile, carrying gift bags.
Andrew! So happy you're here to spend Christmas with us!
I've got some good news for you, Doris. I heard that Farra, the plant manager, is coming by to wish you all a Merry Christmas too! You're truly blessed. Everyone's showing you so much love!
Oh, that's wonderful! DRAVEN BAKER(74) steps out of a room, smiling.
It sure is lively out there. I cut my massage session short just to come join you.
Draven! Perfect timing. This is Andrew, the son of the deputy director at Ravenham Auto Plant. He and Caroline are kind of a special thing and he's here to spend Christmas with us!
Well, isn't he a handsome young man! Andrew takes out a gift box.
Mr. Draven, I've brought you a present. It's a diamond watch and a set of fine wines from the Freya Vineyard.
Andrew, how did you know? Freya wines are my absolute favorite!
Andrew always has the most thoughtful gifts (casts a disdainful look at Riley) Unlike a certain someone who only brings trash to ruin everyone's mood!
Doris, whether you believe me or not, I have to say, a truckload of his stuff can't even cover half of what I got.
You idiot, we've seen right through all your junk! And you're still trying to feed us this crap?
Riley, man, you're hilarious. A broke guy like you trying to act rich in front of me? I don't even know what to say.
I'm curious, what exactly makes you so confident?
Look at this moron! My father is the Vice President of Ravenham Motors, and I'm the head of R&D! That factory is the lifeline of this town. Everyone respects us!
Got it.
You think this is funny? You're not gonna be laughing for long!
Riley, you've disrespected Andrew enough! Apologize now, or nobody will be able to save you!
I don't think I need anybody to save me, Doris. If you really care about him, make him apologize, to me .
Are you insane? What the hell are you saying?
You've got a death wish disrespecting Andrew! Caroline looks anxious. Andrew's face darkens as he stands and approaches Riley.
You got some nerve. I think it's time you learn a lesson. Mess with the wrong guy, you pay the price! Andrew swings a punch at Riley's face. Caroline screams.

No! Riley! Riley catches Andrew's fist, his expression cold. Andrew struggles, trying to pull free, but Riley holds his fist tightly, forces Andrew back, pressing him hard against the wall. Riley twists his wrist outward. Andrew gasps in pain.
If you don't want you and your daddy kicked out of Ravenham Motors, you'd better get on your knees and apologize. Right now.
Grandpa, what the hell is going on?
Is there something wrong with the wine?
I knew it! We should've just tossed that cheap crap! We might get food poisoning from it!
She reaches for the sauce.
Stop! Heidi freezes. Draven pushes her aside, grabs the bowl with the sauce in it, smells it, then dips his pinkie in it and tastes the finger tip.
I knew it. This is a rare vintage from Freya Vinyard! I had it twenty years ago at the Governor's house!
The taste is unforgettable! I would recognize it anywhere! Everyone is stunned. Riley smirks and shakes his head.
How is that possible? But Draven, this bottle says it's from Hall Vineyard, not Freya!
That was the name of Freya Vineyard a hundred years ago!
This is their century-old vintage! One bottle is worth a million dollars! Even the President would struggle to get access to it, and you used it to cook beef!
What? A m- million dollars?
Wait a second, then what about the other stuff Riley brought?
What? Riley gave you more? Bring them to me, now! Heidi hurriedly brings over the other gifts.

I..um.. may have already signed an electronic agreement with the auction house. They're coming tomorrow to collect everything. Draven picks up a brooch and a piece of porcelain, examines them closely, then takes a step back in shock. Caroline hurries over to steady him.
Grandpa!

This brooch is made of pure diamonds. Just that alone makes it priceless. And the craftsmanship... it's definitely a masterpiece! And this porcelain... I've only seen it at a private collection of a corporate CEO! This belongs in a museum! Riley gave you all of this?
Everyone looks at Riley in shock.
You said you sold these to the auction house. How much did you sell them for?
Ten dollars... each...
You idiot! Are you out of your mind? You sold items worth millions for a few bucks! God, you fool!
Everyone looks at each other in panic, then all turn to Riley, who stands with his hands behind his back, a look of pride and confidence on his face.
Draven puts a hand to his head, slightly weak.
Oh, my head… Caroline, worried, rushes to support him. DRAVEN Caroline, could you help me to my room? I'm feeling really dizzy.
Of course, grandpa. Doris stares at the gifts in panic.
How is this possible? Riley brought all of this...how could he afford such expensive gifts?
There's nothing hard about it, Doris. Maybe you've finally started to know me.
Ugh, even if you somehow got all this stuff, your smart mouth still makes me sick.
I still don't believe you could afford them. How did you get them? Wait... did you steal them? Caroline comes back, and catches Nick asking this.
Nick! How can you say that? That's so insulting!
But Caroline... Riley grabs Caroline and pulls her in close.
Nick, stop slandering me with baseless accusations before you really piss me off!
Hold on! Everyone, I just realized something!
Everyone turns to Andrew.
That brooch looks real familiar. Our factory manager at Ravenham Motors, Farra, she had a brooch just like that, and she was gonna have Joseph give it to the chairman of the Wharton Group!
Everyone is taken aback.
So... what are you saying?

Give me that brooch. I'm sending a picture to Joseph. Heidi hands the brooch to Andrew, who takes a photo with his phone. Everyone watches him, waiting. ANDREW This is the one! Andrew raises the brooch, showing his phone. ANDREW This is the brooch that Farra had prepared! Riley, you stole the gift meant for the chairman of Wharton Group!?
Oh, God, you scum! I should've known!
I can't believe you'd do this! You idiot! If Farra finds out, we're all done for!
You filthy thief! You've put us all in trouble. My god, why don't you fucking die already!
Wait! You've got it all wrong!
I've sent the photo to Joseph. The brooch is definitely the one Farra had prepared, no doubt about it!
Caroline, you're still defending him? My poor girl, this filthy man has been lying to you! He's nothing but trash!
Enough! I'm done with your stupidity! I just haven't had the chance to tell you who I really am, but I didn't expect you to expose yourselves like this!
Still committing to the act,huh? Who are you supposed to be? The chairman of Wharton Group? Caroline looks at Riley in disbelief, then suddenly slaps him across the face.
You stole, didn't you?
Caroline?
How else could you possibly get these? Riley, you don't have money, and I've never cared about that. But I can't stand the thought of you stealing and lying! Riley, tell me this isn't true!
Wait, Caroline, how could you believe their lies—— Caroline, teary-eyed, shakes her head in disappointment.
Riley, if you won't tell me the truth, how am I supposed to help you? We could face anything together, but if you can’t be honest with me, then... then after Christmas, we'll get a divorce!
Riley reaches for her hand and holds it tightly in his.
Caroline! Please believe me, these were Farra's gifts to me. I didn't steal anything! I came to tell you the truth about who I really am!
Riley, you keep talking nonsense instead of telling me what's really going on. How can you expect me to believe you?
But I am telling the truth, Caroline!
The doorbell rings. Farra's voice is heard through the door.
Hi! It's Farra!
Everyone turns to the door, shocked.
Farra Ewing? She's here?

Oh no! We can't let Ms. Ewing see this thief with those gifts! We'll never be able to explain it! Quick, get him out of here! Take him through the back door! Nick and Cornell grab Riley and drag him to the back.
Caroline! You have to trust me! (turns to Nick and Cornell) You idiots, let go of me! When you find out the truth, you'll be begging for forgiveness!
Shut up! Let's go!
No!
Don't worry, Caroline. I'll be back soon.
Nick and Cornell drag Riley out. Heidi goes to open the door. Farra enters with a smile, followed by her bodyguards.
Hi, Ms. Ewing! Please, come in!
Merry Christmas, everyone!
She walks over to Caroline.
Caroline, I have great news for you. Thanks to a very concerned gentleman, you're about to be promoted to Head of Public Relations at Ravenham Motors! Caroline is stunned.
Ms. Ewing! Please, come in and have a seat! Farra smiles as everyone gathers around her, guiding her to the sofa. Caroline sits beside her, still shocked.
Ms. Ewing, this is so unexpected, I..don't know what to say. Just having you here to spend Christmas with us is an honor, and now... Farra smiles, holding onto Caroline's hand.
No need to be modest, Caroline. You deserve all of this. And as for the gentleman who's been looking out for you, who got you this promotion, I think you already know who that is...
Andrew! It's Andrew!
Everyone turns to Andrew. He smiles, a bit smug, and steps forward. Fara looks slightly confused.
Ms. Ewing, I'm honored! I only mentioned Caroline's name and I can't believe you'd actually promote her! Thank you for your trust and support! Caroline and I won't let you down!
No, wait....
Andrew, thank you so much! You're the lucky star of the Baker family!
We're so lucky to have you looking out for Caroline, Andrew. We don't know how to thank you!
Thank you, Andrew, but this makes me a little uneasy. Maybe I don't deserve this opportunity. Farra assures her earnestly.
No, Caroline, you're the most deserving person for this position!
What?
Actually, I've been meaning to ask, where's your husband, Mr. Riley Diaz?
Everyone is caught off guard.
I'm sorry, did you just say Riley? Do you know him?
Of course. Aw, you're so humble. You're Riley Diaz's wife, yet you've never even mentioned him. Doris, Nick, and Heidi huddle together, whispering.
Why is Ms. Ewing referring to Riley with such respect? What does she want with him?
She must've found out Riley stole those gifts! She's testing us!
Damn Riley! He's dragging us all down!
What's going on? Is Riley not here? I thought he was coming here to have lunch with you...
No, Ms. Ewing, you're mistaken! We don't know any Riley. Caroline's not his wife!
What?
Wait, mom, what're you talking about? Doris pulls Caroline aside, giving her a warning look to stay quiet.
